title: Mesh-LLM/mesh-llm

title: JetBrains/junie
description: An AI coding agent by JetBrains that ships code from your terminal, IDE, or CI/CD pipeline - powered by any LLM you choose

title: tjpoisal/UNIMATRIX
description: Unimatrix is a cloud-native AI memory system that gives any LLM instant, persistent context across devices and sessions. Dual-layer mem, hybrid retrieval w/ recency decay, a Librarian agent, and enterprise encryption.

title: Osmantic/ODS
description: Turn your PC, Mac, or Linux box into an AI server.  LLM inference, chat UI, voice, agents, workflows, RAG, and image generation.

title: Dezz05/AuraSDK
description: Enable fast, local memory recall for AI agents using a lightweight, Rust-based cognitive memory engine with no cloud or LLM calls needed.

title: esterhuizen/opensidekick

title: AgentParadise/agentic-primitives

title: evinbrijesh/setu
description: A voice-first AI agent that lets Indian citizens navigate government bureaucracy — certificates, welfare schemes, identity documents — by speaking naturally in Hindi, Tamil, or Hinglish. Built with Sarvam AI (STT/LLM/TTS) + Render Workflows + Supabase.

title: ananymishra1/SHIMS

title: lucasmailland/mnemosyne
description: Cognitive memory for AI agents. Bitemporal, multi-tenant Postgres + pgvector. Hybrid recall (BM25 + vectors + graph) with BYO LLM. Use as a library, HTTP API, or MCP server.

title: Resolve-public/writing-assistant-chat
description: AI writing assistant for Obsidian with chat, plan, and edit modes. Connects to local or cloud LLM providers. Features vault-wide RAG retrieval, knowledge graph, agentic tool use, note context, and reusable prompt commands.

title: ljlabs/Route.llm
description: Local LLM proxy and routing engine to bridge Anthropic Messages and OpenAI Chat Completions protocols. Route Claude Code, coding agents, and custom AI clients to OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, or local offline LLM endpoints.

title: Saba-Burduli/agentcore
description: AgentCore is a lightweight local AI-agent execution runtime written in C17. It provides the validated tool-dispatch layer that an LLM or other controller can use later, without embedding a model provider, network client, or shell.

title: XAIHT/Tlamatini
description: Tlamatini is a self-hosted AI developer assistant for local or cloud LLMs: hybrid RAG over your codebase, a 79-tool multi-turn engine, a 74-agent visual workflow designer, and ACPX, a runtime for external coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor and Gemini CLI.

title: api-evangelist/aiignore
description: The .aiignore file is a configuration specification that tells AI coding agents and LLM-powered developer tools which files, directories, and content should not be read, processed, or modified.

title: api-evangelist/stackone
description: StackOne is an AI-powered embedded integration platform as a service (iPaaS) designed to simplify and accelerate how SaaS vendors and AI agents connect with enterprise software.
